title: ForkMesh local SSH authorization broker configuration
description: apiOrigin and gatewayTokenFile are required together unless localAuthorization.mode is "local"; with mode "fallback" both the Worker uplink and the local grants store must be present.

apiConnectAddress.description: Optional loopback ip:port of apiOrigin's own TLS front end on this host (e.g. 127.0.0.1:443), so authorization never leaves the host. The certificate is still verified for apiOrigin's host name. Requires apiOrigin. Leave it out on a separate front host: apiOrigin is then resolved through DNS (for example to a CDN proxy) and verified as usual.

gatewayTokenFile.description: Owner-only file readable by the broker account and by neither SSH-facing account.

localAuthorization.description: Controller-free authorization. "fallback" consults grantsFile only when the Worker is unreachable (never after a denial); "local" never contacts a Worker.

grantsFile.description: Signed forkmesh.ssh-local-grants store mapping keys to accounts and per-repository access.

dynamicRepositoriesFile.description: Node-owned forkmesh.dynamic-repositories fork registry; an account's own forks are implicitly writable.
